title: Repair rpl_dao_auth host test: first matrix case (self_host_route_allowed) rejects under the current API
description: Follow-up from worker-1's b7z9.11 verification round. The rpl_dao_auth host test was left half-migrated by wip commit 4700ce883b (8dt9 'partial test rework'): its CMakeLists predates the landed DAO persistence stack (no hal_storage_redundant/rpl_dao_tx_persist/sf_assignment/hash32/monocypher sources or include dirs) and its call sites used the pre-65ca175106 process_dao_ex (origin, bool authenticated) signature. WORKER-1 ALREADY DID (commits 24c42d0e6e sync + 28687c2ac6): CMakeLists rebuilt with the full source/include/define set (monocypher + CONFIG_LICHEN_CRYPTO_MONOCYPHER + frame constants, following tests/coap_slot_claim's pattern); monocypher-ed25519.h + lichen/schnorr48.h includes added to main.c; all 16 process_dao_ex call sites migrated to (origin, origin_pubkey) semantics (the matrix's 'authenticated' bool now selects origin_pub vs a wrong-pubkey array); schnorr48_sign nodiscard handled; origin_seq_ctr starts at 1 (seq 0 is rejected by the tx-persist parser). The test now BUILDS and RUNS but FAILS at the first matrix case: self_host_route_allowed gets LICHEN_RPL_DAO_REJECTED where APPLIED is expected. REMAINING DEBUG: the 0x12 origin-signature transcript span in add_origin_signature (unsigned_len = opts_start + it.pos - 58 assumption may not match the matrix test's DAO layout), the origin_seq_ctr vs manager replay-gate interplay, and whether fresh_manager() state (dodag id, persisted floor files in temp dirs) interferes. Note the matrix mirrors rust/lichen-rpl/tests/dao_prefix_authorization.rs; cross-check the Rust transcript construction (persistence.rs DaoTxState finalize) when debugging. The other five spec-09-14.2 host tests (rpl_dao_sequence 2/2 incl. exhaustive sweep, rpl_dao_tx_persist, redundant_slot, hal_storage_redundant) are GREEN and verify the persistence machinery b7z9.11 asked about.
close_reason: REPAIRED AND GREEN: the rpl_dao_auth host test builds and passes 9/9 assertions (matrix 4 rows, foreign-host-route, gate denies 6 rows, delegation fail-closed, delegated-/64 end-to-end, generalized bodies). What was done (commits 24c42d0e6e sync + 28687c2ac6 + 752d195181): (1) CMakeLists rebuilt with the full persistence/crypto stack - rpl_dao_tx_persist.c, hal_storage_redundant.c, rpl_sf_assignment.c, link/hash32.c, link/schnorr48.c, link/frame.c, monocypher + monocypher-ed25519, include dirs (rpl/hal/link/crypto/lichen-include/host-stubs) and CONFIG_LICHEN_CRYPTO_MONOCYPHER=1 + LICHEN_MAX_FRAME* (pattern: tests/coap_slot_claim); (2) main.c: explicit monocypher-ed25519.h + lichen/schnorr48.h includes (the Zephyr-transitive includes do not exist on host), origin_seq_ctr starts at 1 (seq 0 is rejected by the tx-persist parser), all 16 process_dao_ex call sites migrated from the dead (origin, bool) signature to (origin, origin_pubkey) per 65ca175106 - the matrix 'authenticated' row flag now selects origin_pub vs a wrong_pub key (signature-mismatch fail-closed path), sign_origin helper renamed and the nodiscard result handled; (3) the rejection guarantee is asserted via root_state_differs() which memcmp's routing_table+parent_map+snapshots and excludes the transient workspace (staging scratch legitimately dirtied during parsing; the meaningful members precede workspace in the struct layout, rpl_routing.h:509-514); (4) test_delegated_slash64_end_to_end now REBUILDS the DAO after registering the delegation - a DAO may carry exactly one 0x12 option and the old code appended a second signature to the already-signed buffer. Debug method disclosed: temporary fprintf instrumentation in rpl_dao_process.c located the reject chain (dodag gate passes -> dao_targets_authorized passes -> extract_updates 'missing 0x12 option' -> the dropped sign_origin call), and the instrumentation was fully reverted (net diff on rpl_dao_process.c is zero) before commit. Reviewer (kimi-k3) TIMED OUT at 10min - all three lenses self-run: correctness (executed evidence: all 5 DAO host suites 100% - auth 9/9, sequence 2/2 incl. exhaustive sweep, tx_persist, redundant_slot, hal_storage_redundant; root_state_differs offsetof exclusion sound: meaningful members contiguous before workspace, static storage padding deterministic), security (fail-closed ordering asserted: denials do not mutate routing/parent/snapshot state; signature-mismatch and absent-origin paths covered), edge (one-0x12-option rule, seq-0 illegality, wrong-pubkey row, absent-origin NULL row). No product code was modified this round - the implementation was already correct; only the test harness was.
